name: simple-web-scraping-service
description: Full-stack product web scraping service with Laravel 12, Next.js 15, and Go proxy microservice.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail --names "proxy,backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" "cd proxy-service && go run main.go" "cd backend && php artisan dev:start" "cd frontend && (bun dev || npm run dev)"
